title: Improve web loading skeletons
summary: Replaced the home page's text-only loading card with a dashboard-shaped skeleton state and added a reusable shadcn-style Skeleton primitive for generic loading states.
userVisibleChange: The web app now keeps the real home page structure visible while snapshots load, using skeleton placeholders instead of a blank loading page.

timeline.title: Added skeleton loading states
timeline.summary: Introduced the Skeleton primitive, converted the shared loader, and gave the home route a dashboard-shaped skeleton.

timeline.title: Verified skeleton state
timeline.summary: Ran clean UI tests/build and inspected desktop/mobile browser screenshots while API requests were held pending.

decisions.title: Use route-specific skeletons for the home page
decisions.rationale: The home page has a distinct dashboard layout, so its loading state should preserve that structure instead of using a generic fallback card.

decisions.title: Add a local shadcn-style Skeleton primitive
decisions.rationale: The app already uses local shadcn-style UI primitives, and a shared Skeleton keeps future loading states consistent.

validation.command: npm run build (ui, clean skeleton-only checkout)
validation.output: TypeScript and Vite production build completed; generated cmd/eve/ui_dist assets updated from the clean build.

validation.command: Playwright visual check with /api/snapshots and /api/repositories held pending
validation.output: Desktop and 390px mobile screenshots showed the app shell plus dashboard-shaped skeletons with no visible text-only loading card or overlapping content.
